prose:
A Wall Street Journal item indexed by Techmeme reports Myriota raised roughly $40 million in the first close of a Series C. The excerpt describes low-power satellite connectivity for industrial IoT and says the funds would support hiring and expansion of its constellation.

The primary article timed out, leaving the investors, final target, commercial terms and operational evidence uninspected. A first close is not necessarily the completed round. The AI-to-physical-world framing is not proof of a particular AI capability, customer outcome or return on investment. This summary stays within the accessible feed excerpt.
highlights: This is a first Series C close, not necessarily the final total
Business is satellite connectivity for industrial IoT
Hiring and constellation expansion are stated plans
No AI capability or investment outcome was validated
